title: Export parameters in 2.8 then import in 2.8.1.1 : The sensor age data was lost
body: I export my parameters in 2.8. Uninstall 2.8 and install 2.8.1.1 and import my parameters. Everything came back EXCEPT the age of the BG sensor, it had no information on the age of the sensor.

comments.body: you have to upgrade AAPS to preserve all data (not remove and install new). import contains only settings
